name: configured-library-authoritative
body: A configured `templates:` path names the deck's external library layer, and it is resolved as written — relative to the deck root, or absolute. A configured path that is missing, not a directory, or not a valid library is a templates error naming that path: kalide never substitutes the local `templates/` for it, there is no fallback from a configured path to a local `templates/`, and there is no silent retarget while serving (template-retarget-requires-restart). The configured value names the external layer's root; the local `templates/` directory is a second layer that contributes to the same library whenever it exists, so a configured path never suppresses the local layer (layered-template-library).
